epic.title: Move house without chaos
epic.identity: Someone who relocates with a calm, usable first week
epic.capability: Plan, pack, move, and settle essentials without losing important documents or sleep
epic.preview: Keys in hand and a sleepable bedroom ready on day one

phases.title: Plan the move
phases.deliverable: Dated checklist + bookings for movers/van and change-of-address list

steps.title: Walk each room and list keep / donate / discard piles
Book movers or van for a firm date
Draft change-of-address and utility transfer list

phases.title: Pack with labels
phases.deliverable: Labeled boxes by room plus an essentials bag for day one

steps.title: Pack kitchen non-essentials and label boxes
Consolidate IDs, contracts, and keys in one folder
Pack the day-one essentials bag (bedding, toiletries, chargers)

phases.title: Settle the essentials
phases.deliverable: Bedroom sleepable, fridge working, and top three utilities confirmed

steps.title: Set up bed and clear a path in the bedroom
Confirm power, water, and internet are live or scheduled
Place a first-week grocery and cleaning run list on the fridge
